description: This file defines the LeaveTypeController class within the Human Resource Management system, specifically for handling leave type-related functionalities in the leave plugin. It extends a base Vue controller and sets up a component for rendering the leave type list.

classes.name: LeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller for managing leave types, inherits from AbstractVueController, and responsible for setting up the leave type list component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by creating a new 'leave-type-list' component and assigning it to the controller.
